title: HealthInformatics EDTriageModelLaunch

stats.done_summary: Completed ED Triage Model Evaluation analysis. Created analysis code (code/analysis.py), generated 4 figures (offline_comparison.png, online_comparison.png, relative_change_forest.png, tradeoff_summary.png), and produced comprehensive report (report/report.md). Key finding: TriageAssist-B shows improved sensitivity (+7.3%) and faster time-to-physician (-14.8%), but significant degradation in LWBS (+64.9%), 72h returns (+36.6%), clinician overrides (+69.8%), and patient complaints (+127.3%). Recommendation: Do not expand to production.
